principals.operatorIdentity: optional, explicit, read-only (ReadAndExecute) on the runtime tree; no write; state gated behind -OperatorStateRead

hostState.hostSource: config.json host, trimmed + lowercased, validated as a single DNS label; never hard-coded
hostState.runtimeDescendants: inherited ACL permitted beneath the protected host-state root; effective ACL must stay broad-write-free with the exact service identity and no reparse path

snapshot.content: exact pre-apply SDDL for every touched path
snapshot.restoreScope: DACL of every captured path (owner/group are never altered by -Apply); paths created by -Apply are removed again, including the pre-staged host-state directory
snapshot.restoreOrder: existing paths top-down so each parent is restored before its children, then apply-created paths children-first so a created parent is empty before removal
snapshot.applyOrder: deepest-first so directory protection never blocks traversal of not-yet-processed children

dryRun: no ACL or filesystem mutation without -Apply

stateChildAcl.canonicalRoot: the exact host-state directory must exist and carry SE_DACL_PROTECTED
stateChildAcl.descendants: runtime children of the protected host-state root (and of logs) may inherit; their effective ACL must remain broad-write-free and contain the exact service SID
stateChildAcl.reparse: reparse/symlink paths stay forbidden anywhere under state/logs
stateChildAcl.note: a missing per-child SE_DACL_PROTECTED flag alone is not reported for runtime descendants beneath host-state/logs
